subject: Night batch POC — emergency headroom & weekend extension
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@skyline-analytics.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: weekend headroom for night-batch POC (throughput sweep)

Hi Mateo,

Quick ask — we have a prep window for our night-batch POC starting Friday night (US PDT) where we plan to run a 12-hour throughput sweep across archived datasets to validate peak latency and tail behavior. The current trial is on-track but we need extra credits + a weekend extension to get reliable percentile stats (p99/p999) and a clean signal for the optimizer.

Attached is the test plan (night-batch-testplan.pdf) and a small sample of the expected throughput trace (throughput-metrics.csv). High level:
- Start: 2028-04-07 22:00 PDT
- Duration: 12–16 hours (overnight)
- Peak RPS target: 5K with variable payloads
- Primary goals: p50/p95/p99/p999 latency, sequence length sensitivity, cache hit-rate impact

Can Redwood provide a temporary extension (48–72 hours) and an additional credit pool (we estimate 40M token-equivalent) so we can run the sweep and collect stable metrics? If possible, we’d like to confirm by Thursday EOD to finalize logistics with our infra team.

Thanks — really appreciate the quick turnaround here.

— Emma
Emma Li
Head of Data Products, Skyline Analytics
emma@skyline-analytics.com
+1 415-555-0198

Hi Emma —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. We can support this but I need to confirm two things internally: 1) exact credit amount to provision and 2) monitoring + on-call window for the night run. I’ve looped in Lauren (ops) and Marissa (customer success) to align on allocation and guardrails.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- I’ll run a quick estimate with Product/Capacity and propose a credit bucket by EOD Wed.
- Marissa will connect to set up a tracing/metrics dashboard and alerting for the run.
- Lauren will review burst policy (autoscale/burst-cap) for the Dedicated pool or hosted fallback.

If you can send a short runbook for start/stop signals and any contract constraints (e.g., data residency), that’ll speed approvals.

I’ll circle back with a single confirmation and any scope limits.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez

mateo@redwood.ai

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Apr 2028 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: weekend headroom for night-batch POC (throughput sweep)

Mateo / Marissa —

Quick internal note after reviewing the plan:
- The target ~5K RPS with 12–16h window maps to ~38–45M token-equivalent depending on avg token/req. I recommend provisioning a 45M token safety bucket.
- We can enable a temporary extension + credit-only allowance on the hosted trial: 72 hours starting 2028-04-07 21:00 PDT.
- Autoscale policy: set to Dedicated pool with burst fallback to hosted to protect latency SLOs. We will set a hard cap for cost protection and a soft cap that triggers alerting at 75% consumption.
- Monitoring: I’ll stand up a lightweight dashboard (token burn, p50/p95/p99, KV cache hit-rate) and add on-call rotation for Saturday night.

Questions for final approval:
1) Do we need contract/legal sign-off for the extension or is a mutual action email sufficient?
2) Any special network/VPC requirements from Skyline that would affect the Dedicated routing?

If no legal required, I can provision the credit bucket and toggle the extension flag. Approving now unless objections from Legal/RevOps.

— Lauren Bishop
Platform Ops | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Emma Li <emma@skyline-analytics.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 6 Apr 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: weekend headroom for night-batch POC (throughput sweep)

Emma —

All set from our side. We’ve provisioned a temporary credit pool of 45M token-equivalent and extended your trial window for 72 hours starting 2028-04-07 21:00 PDT. Notes and guardrails below:

Provisioning details: 45,000,000 token-equivalent (ephemeral bucket)
- Start: 2028-04-07 21:00 PDT
- End: 2028-04-10 21:00 PDT
- Hard cap: usage stops at 48M tokens to prevent runaway costs
- Soft alert: email/slack at 75% consumption (approx 33.75M tokens)
- Monitoring: shared dashboard link (Drive) + we’ll add you to the alert channel for the night run

Operational notes:
- We will keep the Dedicated pool pinned; if capacity issues arise we will seamlessly fallback to the hosted variant (no code changes required).
- Please confirm the runbook start/stop signals by EOD Friday so our on-call can act on them.
- If you need a DocuSign amendment instead of email confirmation, we can route that through RevOps — let me know.

Attachments included: night-batch-testplan.pdf (from you), provisioned-guardrails.txt (internal)

Emma, congrats on getting the sweep scheduled — we’ll be standing by and will send the dashboard link and the alert channel invite in the next hour.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
